title: Outlook for Mac: Purview Data Loss Prevention for calendar events
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap and distinguishes existing email DLP controls from the planned calendar capability. The documented paths and corrected PowerShell call are supported; a conflicting Microsoft troubleshooting article merits a short qualification.

claims.quote: Outlook for Mac will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies for calendar events.

claims.claim: Learn documents DLP policy tips for email in Outlook for Android, iOS and macOS.
claims.quote: Outlook for Android, iOS, and macOS now supports data loss prevention (DLP) policy tips with commonly used predicates and exceptions, advanced classifiers, and override capabilities.

claims.claim: The cited page documents Microsoft Purview portal > Solutions > Data Loss Prevention > Policies > + Create policy.
claims.quote:
Sign in to the Microsoft Purview portal.
Go to Solutions > Data Loss Prevention > Policies > + Create policy.

claims.claim: New-DlpCompliancePolicy -Name <policy name> -ExchangeLocation All -Mode <PolicyMode> uses documented parameters to create an email DLP policy and select its mode.
claims.quote:
New-DlpCompliancePolicy
    [-Name] <String>
    [-ExchangeLocation <MultiValuedProperty>]
    [-Mode <PolicyMode>]
The Mode parameter specifies the action and notification level of the DLP policy.

claims.claim: New-DlpCompliancePolicy runs in Security & Compliance PowerShell.
claims.quote: This cmdlet is available only in Security & Compliance PowerShell.

claims.claim: The printed command includes email for all users.
claims.quote: If you use -ExchangeLocation All by itself, the policy applies to email for all users.

claims.claim: ExchangeLocation accepts All, not a mailbox list.
claims.quote: The ExchangeLocation parameter specifies whether to include email messages in the DLP policy. The valid value for this parameter is All.

claims.claim: The general DLP policy controls are not confirmed as controls over the planned Outlook for Mac calendar capability.
claims.quote: Searched: Outlook Mac calendar events DLP calendar invitations default enable policy tips; "Outlook for Mac" "calendar" "DLP" "conditions" "permissions". Read dlp-create-deploy-policy and New-DlpCompliancePolicy; neither states calendar-event applicability.

claims.claim: General DLP deployment controls cover location scope, actions, and states including simulation, simulation with tips, on and off.
claims.quote:
Use three axes to control the policy deployment process: scope, state, and actions.
Run the policy in simulation mode
Run the policy in simulation mode with policy tips
Turn it on
Keep it off

claims.claim: Microsoft's general deployment guidance recommends simulation with policy tips for a pilot group before full enforcement.
claims.quote: Change the state to Run the policy in simulation mode and show policy tips. Refine the scope of locations to support a pilot group if needed and make use of includes/excludes so that the policy is first rolled out to that pilot group.

claims.claim: The Android, iOS and macOS policy-tip reference says all actions and information types for email communications are supported.
claims.quote: All actions and information types for email communications are supported.
